title: Wow - 7,000 subscribers to Mall World! I wonder if we are all in there together sometimes. Meet you at the Orange Julius!
content: Yeah I've been visiting The Mall for years. I lucid dream a lot. Mine has a bit more of an 80's early 90's vibe to it. Yes, in worked in the mall selling computer games and a book store, so I guess I spent a lot of time in the mall. But it was never traumatic or anything. Also, I worked at the Galleria in Dallas. I know that mall inside out. But wow, THIS one is different. And every time I go back. It's really familiar. I have a two theories. Theory 1. An AI built this mall for us all. I now go into a random store and I look very very very closely at the details. I get really close with my eye and there is such amazing impossible detail. And everything is so creative. I personally am a creative! I'm a travel photographer and an AI artist. And, guys, the stuff and detail and creativity I see in this mall is so amazing! And even though I feel pretty creative, I couldn't make this. I now generate tons of images with AI, and it's so amazing that I feel like it's a possibility. Another time, I was just outside and there was a big black pole with a button on top. Each time I pressed it, a new "Entity" appeared that was impossibly complex and detailed. One time it was a huge Japanese inflatabed baloon robot. Then I'd jam the button again and it replaced that with like an adorable robot-crystal lion. I must have jammed that button like 50 times. My friends were trying to get be to come with them, and I was like, "Are you seeing this shit - it's amazing!" Again, my mind could NOT have created all those things so quickly... Theory 2. I totally believe in simulation theory. And if we are in a simulation, there is probably many simulations happening simultaneously. Like perhaps there are 100 "Treys" all being simulated at the same time, and when we dream, we get to see what the other Treys are up to. Get this. I now always try to find a mirror to see what I look like. Sometimes I see a slightly different version of my face. But one time I looked in the mirror and I was a girl wearing glasses in her 20s. She was kinda chubby but kinda cute and she had a bunch of gaps in her teeth. Last night I looked down at a mirrored table and it was my face, but it looked like I had a goatee made out of black electrical tape. Who knows. Another funny story from a place to get snacks in there. I often do see people that I know. Even my ex-wife and kids and old friends. But I was getting a snack and I looked over to my right and it was that funny guy from Wings and Sideways - Thomas Haden Church. It was 100% him. And I said, "Oh hey you're that hilarious actor from Sideways!" And he was really funny and said, "Yes, but I guess I'm not much of an actor any more." I'm gonna send Thomas a tweet and see if he remembers meeting me in The Mall. I'll report back! &#x200B;
